# Correct the collector’s default-behavior comment from the actual branch

The accepted collector introduction says it saves without checking for an existing card by default, while the implementation checks unless skipCheckExisting is truthy. A scoped documentation recommendation is to describe the default check and the explicit bypass separately. The optional argument’s JSDoc does not establish a formal JavaScript default initializer in the function signature. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/compose/src.
